g.text: HUP060 run-02: unified zero-control distribution error

text.style: font-size: 5.9px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: The same 36 electrodes are aligned across panels. Small mean error but larger SD error indicates that most W1 mismatch comes from distribution width.

text.style: font-size: 5.4px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Rows are ordered by W1 in panel a. Dashed lines show all-electrode medians. Electrode summaries are descriptive within one patient; no independent-sample inference is made.
